verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a full public RESTful API for driving applicant verification, with sandbox testing, webhooks, and even an official MCP server for AI agents to perform operations under existing role permissions. This directly supports AI-native, API-driven usage beyond just the UI SDKs. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found all standard OpenAPI endpoints returning 404) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness.
